digest.component_or_area: criteria vocabulary management and repository scanning
propositions: Residual live prose in src/rebar/llm/completion.py and tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py must be migrated from success criteria to acceptance criteria terminology

A deterministic repository scanner with count-pinned allowlist must detect and reject unallowlisted Success Criteria vocabulary reintroductions outside frozen migration evidence and permanent semantic carve-outs

The guard must enforce scoped bare-token rules for SC/SCs only under src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md
The root Makefile lint target must wire the guard directly so local make lint and CI enforce the same check

Allowlist malformations, count drift, duplicate paths, and stale entries must fail deterministically while preserving exactly-counted deliberate matches in Jira fixtures, migration probes, reviewer carve-outs, and historical citations
All four O-RAN-SC sites must remain byte-identical to commit a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c and excluded from bare-token scanning
